events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip and asserted a rider no-show, so the fee is only chargeable if NS-1 is satisfied in full [F3][NS-0]. The record shows the driver did tap "I'm Here" at 08:48:15, satisfying NS-1(i) [F5][NS-1].

However, NS-1(ii) fails: at the moment of the tap the driver was 350 m from the pickup point, and the driver's closest approach during the entire trip was 288 m, so he never entered the 200 m arrival radius [F5][F1][NS-1]. NS-1(iii) also fails: GPS shows he stayed 0 s continuously inside the radius after the tap, and the platform never recorded arrival at the pickup (driver_arrived_at is null) [F5][F4][NS-1].

The driver's contrary statements — the "I'm here already" chat at 08:48 and his claim of pressing "I'm Here" and waiting more than 3 minutes at the pickup — conflict with the GPS and timeline records, which take precedence [F9][F11][F12][F1][F5][F2]. In any event, his chat message at 08:48 was sent while he was still ~350 m away, and the rider's reply confirms she was at the pickup point and saw no car [F9][F10][F2].

With NS-1(i)(ii)(iii) not all met, the $6.61 cancellation fee does not stand and must be refunded in full [F7][NS-2]. Because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS places him outside the pickup radius, this is an abuse of the waiting/cancellation button and an account flag is warranted [F5][F1][NS-2].

No safety trigger applies: the dispute type is no_show, there is no threat-tagged chat, and no incident, congestion, or weather factor is in play [F13][F14][F15][SAFE-1]. Amount owed: the full cancellation fee on record, $6.61 [F7][NS-2]. Per NS-7 this is issued as a voucher rather than cash [NS-7].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news: your $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded in full. You were charged a no-show fee, but the driver's location data shows he was still about 350 m from your pickup point when he tapped "I'm Here" and he never came within the required 200 m, so the fee doesn't stand. Your message confirming you were waiting at the pickup point supports this. The $6.61 comes to you as a Ryde voucher, not cash. No further action is needed from you — sorry for the trouble, and thanks for flagging it.

DRIVER: Your cancellation fee claim for this trip was not upheld. GPS records show you tapped "I'm Here" about 350 m from the pickup point, and your closest approach was roughly 288 m — never inside the 200 m arrival radius the no-show fee requires. Your account is being sent to Ryde for review of that "I'm Here" tap and a related account flag. That means the trip was paid as a normal cancellation rather than a no-show fee. No action is needed from you now; Ryde will follow up if the review requires anything.
